claims.text: Iorlas was an uncle of Bergil, either Beregond's brother or brother-in-law. When Pippin mentioned to Bergil he was 29 years old, this surprised him, as his uncle Iorlas was also 29, and nigh twice as tall as the Hobbit.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Return of the King, "Minas Tirith"
